# 3rd Annual Americas Cash & Connectivity Day in NY

Santander brings clients and industry leaders together in New York for third Americas Cash & Connectivity Forum.


Santander hosted its third annual Americas Cash & Connectivity Forum in New York City, bringing together clients, partners and industry leaders to exchange perspectives on the forces reshaping treasury and cash management.


Video file


Held on October 29 at Santander’s 22 Vanderbilt offices, the Forum brought together expertise from across Santander and organizations including Accenture, AWS, Oracle, BNY, Getnet, Solventum, BCG, Paxos and The Clearing House.


The day centered on a question increasingly important to companies: how can businesses move beyond the hype surrounding innovation and turn it into tangible value?


Artificial intelligence was a major part of that conversation. Leaders from Santander, Accenture, AWS and Oracle explored how AI is moving from experimentation toward practical corporate applications, including the emerging role of agentic AI in the enterprise.


The Forum also examined how payments are evolving from transactions into more connected, client-centric experiences, as well as developments shaping the future of money — from FX, stablecoins and tokenized deposits to liquidity and in-house banking strategies.


With Santander leaders from the U.S., Argentina, Brazil and Chile participating, the discussions also highlighted the importance of connecting opportunities across the Americas and combining local market expertise with global capabilities.


The Forum comes as Santander continues to build momentum in the U.S. and deepen its relationships with corporate and institutional clients. By bringing clients together with experts from across industries, technologies and markets, the event created an opportunity to exchange ideas, challenge assumptions and explore how emerging trends can translate into practical solutions.


Now in its third year, the Americas Cash & Connectivity Forum reflects Santander’s commitment to staying close to its clients and creating the connections that help them navigate an increasingly complex and interconnected world.
